items.name: auth-provider
items.title: Auth Provider
items.description: Wraps the Better Auth UI provider and mounts an ErrorToaster that surfaces query and mutation failures via sonner.

items.name: additional-field
items.title: Additional Field
items.description: Renders a configured additional user field on the sign-up form and user profile, with support for string, number, boolean, date, datetime, select, combobox, slider, and hidden types.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign In
items.description: A complete sign-in form component with email/password and social provider support.

items.name: anonymous
items.title: Anonymous
items.description: Adds a Continue as guest button backed by Better Auth's anonymous plugin.

items.name: agent-auth
items.title: Agent Auth
items.description: Capability approval and grant revocation UI for Better Auth Agent Auth.

items.name: sso
items.title: SSO and Email-First Sign In
items.description: Discovers organization SSO from an email address, then falls back to configured password, email OTP, magic-link, or plugin sign-in methods.

items.name: last-login-method
items.title: Last Login Method
items.description: Adds a localized last-used indicator to email and social sign-in methods tracked by Better Auth.

items.name: one-tap
items.title: Google One Tap
items.description: Updates the authentication surfaces with the headless prompt slot used by the Google One Tap UI plugin.

items.name: sign-up
items.title: Sign Up
items.description: A complete sign-up form component with name, email, password fields, and social provider support.

items.name: email-otp
items.title: Email OTP
items.description: Email OTP plugin: passwordless sign-in with an emailed code, plus code-based replacements for email verification, password reset, and email changes.

items.name: phone-number
items.title: Phone Number
items.description: Phone-number plugin with verification-code and password sign-in, password recovery, and verified phone-number management.

items.name: magic-link
items.title: Magic Link
items.description: Magic-link plugin: passwordless email sign-in form, toggle button between password and magic-link routes, and the AuthPlugin scaffolding that registers the view with `<Auth>`.

items.name: billing
items.title: Billing
items.description: Provider-neutral plans, subscription, portal, seats, cancellation, restoration, and usage settings with Stripe and Polar adapters.

items.name: dash
items.title: Dash Activity
items.description: Personal activity and role-aware organization audit logs backed by Better Auth Infrastructure Dash.

items.name: oauth-provider
items.title: OAuth Provider
items.description: OAuth Provider plugin: authorization screens, connected applications, and personal or organization OAuth client management.

items.name: device-authorization
items.title: Device Authorization
items.description: Device authorization plugin: code entry, sign-in continuation, and approve or deny actions for Better Auth device requests.

items.name: username
items.title: Username
items.description: Username plugin: username-based sign-in form and availability checking field. Registers a sign-in view that accepts both username and email, and a username field with real-time availability checking rendered on the sign-up form.

items.name: passkey
items.title: Passkey
items.description: Passkey plugin: WebAuthn sign-in button and passkey management card. Registers a passkey sign-in button on the sign-in form and a Passkeys security card in account settings.

items.name: siwe
items.title: Sign in with Ethereum
items.description: ERC-4361 wallet sign-in with optional email collection and server-authorized wallet account management.

items.name: two-factor
items.title: Two-Factor
items.description: Two-factor plugin: the post-password challenge for authenticator, emailed, and backup codes, plus the settings card for enrollment and backup-code management.

items.name: api-key
items.title: API Key
items.description: API Key plugin: list, create, copy, and revoke API keys. Registers an API Keys security card in account settings.

items.name: admin
items.title: Admin
items.description: Admin plugin integration that adds a stop-impersonating action to the user button while an administrator is impersonating another user.

items.name: multi-session
items.title: Multi Session
items.description: Multi-session plugin: Enable multiple concurrent sessions with account switching. Registers account management cards in account settings and a switch account submenu in the user button.

items.name: organization
items.title: Organization
items.description: Organization plugin: multi-tenant organization management with members, invitations, and roles. Registers direct invitation acceptance, an organizations settings tab, a full `<Organization />` shell, and an `<OrganizationSwitcher />` dropdown.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Theme plugin: theme-library agnostic theme selection. Registers an Appearance card in account settings and a theme toggle in the user button. Pass `useTheme` from your theme library (e.g. next-themes) or static `setTheme`.

items.name: delete-user
items.title: Delete User
items.description: Delete-user plugin: danger zone with DeleteAccount card and confirmation dialog. Registers a DangerZone security card in account settings when the plugin is registered.

items.name: forgot-password
items.title: Forgot Password
items.description: A form component for requesting a password reset link via email.

items.name: reset-password
items.title: Reset Password
items.description: A form component for resetting password with a token from the URL.

items.name: verify-email
items.title: Verify Email
items.description: A page prompting the user to verify their email, with a button to open their email provider and a resend button rate-limited by a cooldown timer.

items.name: auth-redirect
items.title: Auth Redirect
items.description: A session-aware redirect view that safely continues authenticated users to a same-origin target or sends them through sign in first.

items.name: sign-out
items.title: Sign Out
items.description: A component that signs the user out when mounted and displays a loading state.

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth
items.description: A unified authentication component that renders the appropriate auth view based on path or view prop.

items.name: user-avatar
items.title: User Avatar
items.description: Renders the current user's avatar using session data. Shows a skeleton while loading and falls back to initials when no image is available.

items.name: user-view
items.title: User View
items.description: Renders a user view that shows the user's avatar alongside their name and email.

items.name: user-button
items.title: User Button
items.description: Renders a user button with dropdown menu showing user info, settings link, plugin-contributed menu items (e.g. theme toggle, account switcher), and sign-in/sign-out actions.

items.name: user-profile
items.title: User Profile
items.description: A form component for editing user profile information including name and avatar.

items.name: change-email
items.title: Change Email
items.description: A form component for changing the user's email address with verification.

items.name: account-settings
items.title: Account Settings
items.description: A container component that displays account settings including user profile, change email, and plugin-contributed account cards (e.g. appearance from the theme plugin, multi-session accounts).

items.name: change-password
items.title: Change Password
items.description: A form component for users to change their password with current password verification.

items.name: linked-accounts
items.title: Linked Accounts
items.description: Display and manage linked social accounts. Shows all linked social accounts with the ability to unlink them, followed by available providers that can be linked.

items.name: active-sessions
items.title: Active Sessions
items.description: Display and manage all active sessions for the current user with revoke controls. Shows each session's browser, OS, and creation time.

items.name: security-settings
items.title: Security Settings
items.description: A container component that displays security settings including password management, linked accounts, plugin-contributed security cards (e.g. passkeys), active sessions, and danger zone.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: A unified settings component that renders the appropriate settings view based on path or view prop with tab navigation.

items.name: email-verification-email
items.title: Email Verification Email
items.description: Email template component that sends email verification links to users.

items.name: magic-link-email
items.title: Magic Link Email
items.description: Email template component that sends magic link authentication emails for passwordless sign-in.

items.name: reset-password-email
items.title: Reset Password Email
items.description: Email template component that sends password reset links to users.

items.name: change-email-confirmation-email
items.title: Change Email Confirmation Email
items.description: Email template component for approving an email address change from the current address.

items.name: delete-account-verification-email
items.title: Delete Account Verification Email
items.description: Email template component for verifying a permanent account deletion request.

items.name: password-changed-email
items.title: Password Changed Email
items.description: Email template component that notifies users when their password has been changed.

items.name: email-changed-email
items.title: Email Changed Email
items.description: Email template component that notifies users when their email address has been changed.

items.name: otp-email
items.title: OTP Email
items.description: Email template component that sends one-time password (OTP) verification codes to users.

items.name: new-device-email
items.title: New Device Email
items.description: Email template component that notifies users when a new device signs in to their account.

items.name: organization-invitation-email
items.title: Organization Invitation Email
items.description: Email template component that invites a user to join an organization.

items.name: all
items.title: All
items.description: Installs every Better Auth UI component, plugin, and email template in one shot.
